summary: Iteration 2 testing for PAYO redesign + new features (voice/STT, withdraw, daily summary, custom SuccessModal). Backend: 20/20 pytest passing covering banks, daily-summary, transactions date filter, withdraw (valid/<50k/invalid bank), voice/parse-text (transfer + withdraw intents) plus regression of dashboard/today, exchange-rate, transactions, recent-recipients, transfer, qris/static, qris/generate. Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport) verified end-to-end on the public preview URL: dashboard renders new 4-button 2x2 grid (Transfer, Scan QRIS, Input Nominal QRIS, Open QRIS) plus 'Tarik Pendapatan QRIS Sekarang' row with subtitle, PAYO logo top-left. Open QRIS opens a bottom-sheet overlay on the SAME dashboard route (URL stays at '/'); modal shows Milea Concert QR + merchant ID PAYO00012345 + Bagikan QRIS button. Pendapatan tab shows 8 daily aggregate cards, tapping a card opens day-detail screen with summary card, paginated tx list (1/2 with Sebelumnya/Berikutnya buttons), and back-to-days control. Transfer screen renders voice mic card + recipient list + form + custom SuccessModal on submit. Withdraw screen renders 6 bank chips, account/holder/amount fields, quick-amount chips, fee preview (Rp500.000 → Biaya 0,5% Rp2.500 → Diterima Rp497.500), and elegant SuccessModal on submit. Below-minimum amount correctly blocks success. Voice text fallback successfully parses 'transfer 25 USDT ke Andi Wijaya' via /api/voice/parse-text and auto-fills both address (matched to Andi Wijaya in recipient list) and amount fields.

minor.issue: Hardcoded fallback total_usdt=9020.21/count=5 when no IN-direction tx today — could mask real zero-income state in prod. Carryover from iteration 1.

ui_bugs.issue: When LLM returns recipient='Andi' (first name only) but recipients list hasn't fully loaded yet OR the name shorter than full, the substring match (recipients.find(r => r.name.toLowerCase().includes(intent.recipient.toLowerCase()))) sometimes leaves address empty. With full name 'Andi Wijaya' it works perfectly. Suggest also matching on first-name-only or showing a chooser when ambiguous.

Uses Alert.alert with two buttons (Batal/Buka) to redirect to /withdraw. On web this is the native confirm dialog — works but inconsistent with new SuccessModal aesthetic. Consider an inline banner or custom modal.

issues: Verify Platform.OS==='web' fallback is now ABOVE permission check — main agent reported this was fixed; UI flow worked in this iteration test.

action_items: (LOW) transfer.tsx: improve recipient name matching — also check first-name-only match and/or show recipient picker when intent.recipient given but no exact match found, instead of silently leaving address blank.
(LOW) transfer.tsx: replace the Alert.alert that asks 'Buka halaman Withdraw?' with an in-app confirm UI consistent with the new SuccessModal style.
(OPTIONAL, carryover) backend dashboard/today: remove hardcoded 9020.21 fallback when no IN tx today.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses os.environ['MONGO_URL']/DB_NAME correctly, CORS open, _id excluded everywhere via serialize_tx — clean.
Withdraw fee math correct (0.5% rounded), proper validation (<50k → 400, invalid bank → 400), persisted as USDT-equivalent OUT transaction.

/api/voice/parse-text uses LLM via emergentintegrations with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, falls back to rule parser on failure — robust. Whisper /voice/parse not exercised (requires native mic) but text fallback fully covered.
All Expo screens use SafeAreaView/View/Text/TouchableOpacity correctly; comprehensive testID coverage on every interactive element.
StaticQrisOverlay uses RN Modal with animationType='slide' — opens as bottom sheet without route change (verified URL stays at '/').
Pendapatan tab uses a single FlatList for both day-list and day-detail with proper state guard (selectedDate) — pagination wired to /api/transactions?date=YYYY-MM-DD.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_payo_api.py (extended from 12 → 20 tests adding banks, withdraw, daily-summary, date filter, voice parse-text)

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all critical flows verified (dashboard 4-grid + withdraw row, QRIS overlay, pendapatan day-detail w/ pagination, transfer + voice intent + SuccessModal, withdraw + fee preview + SuccessModal, all navigations)

seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 20 transactions on first hit. Tests created a few TEST_-tagged transfers and withdraws (left in DB; benign noise).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://qvac-payment-suite.preview.emergentagent.com. Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_payo_api.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. For UI tests use mobile viewport 390x844. Register page.on('dialog', lambda d: asyncio.create_task(d.accept())) to auto-accept Alert.alert (used in transfer onIntent withdraw branch and validation alerts). Wait at least 2s after clicking Open QRIS / day-card / voice text submit — there are slide animations + LLM round-trips (~3-5s) involved. The voice text fallback endpoint is /api/voice/parse-text (form-encoded, key 'text'); /api/voice/parse needs real audio file and was not exercised.
rca_of_issue: No critical bugs. Two minor LOW-priority UX issues in transfer.tsx (first-name-only recipient matching, Alert.alert for withdraw redirect). One carryover cosmetic issue (hardcoded today fallback). All 19 review-request items verified working: 6 banks, daily-summary, date-filtered transactions, withdraw success/min/invalid-bank, voice parse-text transfer/withdraw, regression endpoints, dashboard 4-grid + withdraw row, QRIS overlay (no route change), Transfer/Withdraw screens with mic, fee preview, SuccessModal, pendapatan daily cards + day detail + pagination, all navigations (Lihat Detail, Lihat Semua, Input Manual, Scan QRIS).
